links.evidence: In the United Kingdom, we partner in a cost-sharing arrangement with another supplier, Bacardi Limited, to sell a portfolio of both companies’ brands.
For 2010, Corning’s sales to AU Optronics Corporation, a customer of our Display Technologies segment, represented 11% of the Company’s consolidated net sales.
